newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakhs announce bidders for Pavlodar oil refinery.
newsitem.headline: Kazakhs announce bidders for Pavlodar oil refinery.

text.p: Kazakhstan named on Wednesday six bidders in a tender for the former Soviet republic's state-owned Pavlodar oil refinery.

State Property Committee spokesman Mirkhat Nigmatulin told Reuters that Canada's Hurricane Hydrocarbons Ltd, Britains's CCL Oil and Inter-Mediterranean Petroleum Co UK Ltd, Access Industries of the United States and Kazakhstan's Amaday and Radical had submitted bids.
He gave no information on when a winner would be announced.
The Pavlodar refinery, in the north of the oil-rich nation and near the border with Russia, has a capacity of about 7.5 million tonnes per year, according to official figures.

Last year, Hurricane Hydrocarbons won control of 90 percent of Kazakhstan's Yuzhneftegas oil enterprise in the south of the country after it promised to pay off the company's debts and invest $280 million over six years.

The Kazakh government, in a massive sell-off of most of the country's energy enterprises, has said it aims to speed up privatisation, but several tenders in the Central Asian nation's oil sector have been delayed.
